data.narrative:
Texture Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Sanjiv Sanghavi, Victor Quinn, and Nicholas Brown. The target operates within a broader Climate & Energy sector comprising 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage companies with comparable valuation profiles to support a robust peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology applied to the $24.3M total raised as a proxy baseline. Using a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $49M. This method is the only applicable triangulation technique given the absence of three or more narrow-set peers. A conservative bound range of $41M to $56M reflects reasonable variance around the $49M median estimate, acknowledging both execution risk and early-stage uncertainty.

Key uncertainties center on the applicability of the 2.0x step-up multiplier in a sector where capital intensity and market timing drive outcomes unpredictably. The single-method reliance introduces material sensitivity to that assumption. A broader peer median would be preferable but cannot be justified with available narrow-set data. Further diligence on unit economics and market positioning would materially refine this range.
